title: pvKMeans
body:
## pvKMeans Clusters observations into k groups (ParaView default 5) in the space spanned by the selected arrays, iterating until cluster centres move less than Tolerance or MaxIterations is reached. The model is the set of centres; assessment labels each point or cell with its nearest cluster and the distance to it, e.g. to segment flow regimes. Output port 0 is the statistical model (a multiblock of tables) and port 1 the input with assessment arrays added; select them with {"node": id, "port": n}. Common mistakes and assumptions: - Distances are Euclidean in raw array units, so variables with large magnitudes dominate; normalize them first (calculator). - Task 3 (Model and assess the same data) assesses data that also trained the model, which flatters the fit; prefer a separate data set via ModelInput. - Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation. Native constructor: `KMeans`. Identity: `filters/KMeans`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`. ### Inputs | Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input to the filter. Arrays from this dataset will be used for computing statistics and/or assessed by a statistical model. Accepted data: image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData); curvilinear structured grids (vtkStructuredGrid); polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData); unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid); tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable); graphs (vertices and edges) (vtkGraph). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData","vtkStructuredGrid","vtkPolyData","vtkUnstructuredGrid","vtkTable","vtkGraph"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` | | `ModelInput` | Optional data input for the native ModelInput port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: A previously-calculated model with which to assess a separate dataset. This input is optional. Accepted data: tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable); multiblock datasets (vtkMultiBlockDataSet). | False | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkTable","vtkMultiBlockDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` | ### Options | Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `AttributeMode` | Attribute association whose arrays are analysed; VariablesofInterest names are looked up in it. Chosen by the ParaView entry text: "Point Data", "Cell Data", "Vertex Data", "Edge Data", "Row Data" or "Field Data". ParaView offers only the associations the connected input has (for example "Row Data" for a table), so a text it does not offer fails with NATIVE_DOMAIN_MISMATCH when the node is configured. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Point Data","Cell Data","Vertex Data","Edge Data","Row Data","Field Data"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Point Data"` | | `MaxIterations` | Specify the maximum number of iterations in which cluster centers are moved before the algorithm terminates. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` | | `Task` | Specify the task to be performed: modeling and/or assessment.
  1. "Detailed model of input data," creates a set of output tables containing a calculated statistical model of the entire input dataset;
  2. "Model a subset of the data," creates an output table (or tables) summarizing a randomly-chosen subset of the input dataset;
  3. "Assess the data with a model," adds attributes to the first input dataset using a model provided on the second input port; and
  4. "Model and assess the same data," is really just operations 2 and 3 above applied to the same input dataset. The model is first trained using a fraction of the input data and then the entire dataset is assessed using that model.
When the task includes creating a model (i.e., tasks 2, and 4), you may adjust the fraction of the input dataset used for training. You should avoid using a large fraction of the input data for training as you will then not be able to detect overfitting. The Training fraction setting will be ignored for tasks 1 and 3. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Detailed model of input data","Model a subset of the data","Assess the data with a model","Model and assess the same data"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Detailed model of input data"` | | `Tolerance` | Specify the relative tolerance that will cause early termination. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` | | `TrainingFraction` | Specify the fraction of values from the input dataset to be used for model fitting. The exact set of values is chosen at random from the dataset. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` | | `VariablesofInterest` | Choose arrays whose entries will be used to form observations for statistical analysis. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` | | `k` | Specify the number of clusters. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` | Execution contract: ```json { "mode": "serial", "performance": "unknown" } ``` Coverage and unbound native properties: ```json { "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options", "gaps": {}, "origin": "generated", "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available", "outputPorts": 2, "qualification": "not-run" } ``` ### Syntax example Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer. ```json { "id": "result", "filter": "pvKMeans", "inputs": { "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input" } } ```
